triage.kind_span: SLRC and SUNS are proposing a combination of both companies by a merger and related transactions pursuant to the Merger Agreement in which Merger Sub would merge with and into SUNS

subject_names.value: SLR Investment Corp.; SLR Senior Investment Corp.
subject_names.span: SLR Senior Investment Corp., a Maryland corporation (SUNS), SLRC, Solstice Merger Sub, Inc., a Maryland corporation and a direct wholly-owned subsidiary of SLRC

subject_tickers.span: SLRC Common Stock trades on The Nasdaq Global Select Market (Nasdaq) under the ticker symbol SLRC. SUNS Common Stock trades on the Nasdaq under the symbol SUNS.

security_class.span: each share of common stock, par value $0.01 per share, of SUNS (SUNS Common Stock) issued and outstanding immediately prior to the Effective Time

acquirer.span: with SUNS continuing as the surviving company and as a wholly owned subsidiary of SLRC. Immediately after the effectiveness of the Merger, SUNS will merge with and into SLRC

targets.span: Merger Sub would merge with and into SUNS (the Merger), with SUNS continuing as the surviving company

n_targets.span: Merger Sub would merge with and into SUNS (the Merger), with SUNS continuing as the surviving company

exchange_basis.span: The Exchange Ratio will be equal to the quotient (rounded to four decimal places) of (i) the SUNS Per Share NAV divided by (ii) the SLRC Per Share NAV.

collar.span: There will be no adjustment to the Merger Consideration for changes in the market price of shares of SLRC Common Stock.

spans: Closing of the Mergers is contingent upon (a) SLRC stockholder approval of the Merger Stock Issuance Proposal, (b) SUNS stockholder approval of the Merger
it is a condition to the obligations of SUNS and of SLRC to consummate the Mergers that SUNS and SLRC will together obtain a legal opinion to that effect

expected_close.span: SLRC and SUNS are working to complete the Mergers in the first half of 2022.

notes: Preliminary N-14 (dated Dec 15, 2021); meeting and record dates are blank placeholders. Exchange ratio is set at closing from NAVs (floating); 0.7763 is only an illustrative figure from Sept 30, 2021 NAVs including transaction costs, so exchange_ratio is null. Merger Agreement dated December 1, 2021. Outside date not within the excerpt. Collar false inferred from the statement of no adjustment for SLRC market price changes.
